law_name: Law No. 24-82 of July 7, 1982 on Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 61; joint works: last surviving author + 50 years; anonymous and cinematographic works 50 years from creation; photographs 25 years)
enforcement_body: Congolese Copyright Office (Bureau Congolais du Droit d'Auteur, BCDA) (unconfirmed)
notes: Congo is an OAPI member (Bangui Agreement Annex VII also applicable); WIPO Lex lists Law 24-82 as main national law; BCDA described as collecting society so its role as regulator is unconfirmed; TRIPS/WCT/WPPT not checked
